language.hint: You can change it anytime in Settings.

audience.title: Who is using this app?
audience.help: Used only to show bayans meant for you. Saved on this phone. You can change it anytime in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy at a glance
privacy.noAccount: No account. No name or phone number.
privacy.location: Your location never leaves your phone.
privacy.stored: We store only: a random app ID, your language, brother/sister choice, the masjids you follow and a notification token.
privacy.offline: You’re offline. The app will finish setting up when you’re back online.

masjid.title: Add your first masjid
masjid.body: Scan the QR code on the poster at your masjid, or type the code written under it.

install.title: Keep the app on your phone
install.body: Install it to open it from your home screen, even without internet.

followFailed: We couldn’t add that masjid right now. Open the link again when you’re online.
